decision_reason: M1166 may only run the small staged relocation pilot and compare it to M1161. It cannot rerun mining or outcome gates, train actor weights, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, change actor inputs, convert the pilot surface, or claim full surface pass.
failure_criteria: pilot exceeds resource budget and must be interrupted
actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, mining rerun, outcome rerun, conversion, or actor-input change starts
forbidden_shortcuts: do not convert the pilot surface
do not claim full surface pass from pilot diagnostic
hypothesis: A small wrong-history-only body-offset relocation pilot can complete quickly and indicate whether body-offset expansion improves accepted wrong-history surface quality over M1161.

blocked_by: M1165 designs the resource-bounded staged pilot
parent_objective: run a small relocation-expansion pilot over existing M1161 outcomes

public_gates: M1166 may run only the M1165 pilot command
M1166 must reuse the existing M1161 outcome CSV
M1166 must not rerun outcome gate
M1166 must not train actor weights
M1166 must not use private holdout
M1166 must not convert the pilot surface
success_criteria: no actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, mining rerun, outcome rerun, conversion, or actor-input change occurs
